before.name: security traded
before.description: Reference to the security being traded. Statistically it joins to SECURITY.SECURITYID (also plausibly LISTEDSECURITY or FINANCIALINSTRUMENT, which are likely related/superclass entities); the exact target table is not statistically confirmed.

after.name: financial instrument / security traded
after.description: Reference to the financial instrument involved in the transaction. The column has accepted joins to FINANCIALINSTRUMENT.FINANCIALINSTRUMENTID, SECURITY.SECURITYID and LISTEDSECURITY.LISTEDSECURITYID, whose ID values share the same range (1001000-1005649), indicating a generalization hierarchy: FINANCIALINSTRUMENT is the superclass, with SECURITY and LISTEDSECURITY as specializations of the same underlying instrument. The column therefore identifies the instrument/security being traded, most directly a row of FINANCIALINSTRUMENT (equivalently its SECURITY/LISTEDSECURITY subtype).
